The '''''Aculeus''''' was a [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]] that was part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its short-lived successor, the [[Dark Empire]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was one of five ''Mandator III''-class [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnoughts]] to be part of the Dark Empire's [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|attack]] on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&ndash;controlled [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="date" /> Although the Imperial assault was initially quite successful, various Imperial factions turned on one another in a mad frenzy known as the [[Imperial Civil War|Imperial Mutiny]]. As part of that conflict,<ref name="TEGtW" /> which also occurred in 10 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="date" /> the ''Aculeus'' was destroyed in battle with [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/D automated starfighter]]s at<ref name="TEGtW" /> the [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Drearia/Legends|Drearia]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Aculeus'' was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
